newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Treasury sets state note coupons.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Treasury sets state note coupons.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury said in a statement on Monday BELJ it set the coupon for the second issue of its five-year state note, extendable to seven years, at 5.45 percent.
The first coupon for the second issue of a 3/5/7 note, which bears a revisable coupon and put options at three, five and seven years and with a guaranteed minimum coupon, was set at 4.50 percent.
This second issue under the new medium-term notes programme will be launched on September 18.
The first issue in June raised a total of 16.65 billion francs.
The finance ministry has said it aimed to raise around 85 billion francs through four issues in 12 months.
